errors.UPDATE_NOTHING_STAGED: Nothing is staged beside this install, so there is nothing to install.
errors.UPDATE_MODE_UNKNOWN: {{mode}} is not a word for an update: when idle, now or not now.
errors.REMOTE_HALF_DECLARED: {{workspace}} needs both an address and a key. A half-declared remote is no remote — one written into the map would simply be skipped.
errors.REPOSITORY_NOT_ADOPTED: {{repository}} has not adopted Daoris, so there is no declaration to edit. Its own agent runs the adoption; this form changes one that already exists.
errors.DRIVER_NOT_READY: The driver is still coming up — its service is not answering yet. A moment.
errors.SERVICE_UNREACHABLE: The service is not answering. What is on screen is the last it said, until it answers again.
errors.HARNESS_ACTION_UNKNOWN: There is no agent action called {{action}}.
errors.HARNESS_ACTION_IDLE: Nothing is running for {{harness}} {{action}} — it finished, or was never started.
errors.HARNESS_ACTION_BUSY: {{running}} is still running — wait for it to end, or stop it, before starting another.
errors.ACCOUNT_ACTION_UNKNOWN: There is no account action called {{action}}.
errors.ACCOUNT_ORDER_UNKNOWN: {{agent}} has no account {{account}} on this machine, so a list cannot name it. Its accounts: {{accounts}}.
errors.ACCOUNT_ORDER_TWICE: {{account}} is named twice — a list names each account once, in the order it is used.
errors.ACCOUNT_SCOPE_DEFAULT: This machine's default for {{agent}} is {{account}}, and the list would not hold it — the default is where starts begin within the list. Make one of the list the default first.
errors.ACCOUNT_SCOPE_DEFAULT_workspace: {{workspace}}'s default for {{agent}} is {{account}}, and the list would not hold it — the default is where starts begin within the list. Make one of the list the default first.
errors.ACCOUNT_SCOPE_KEEP: {{account}} is kept for conversations, and the list does not hold it — the kept account is one of the list. Keep none first, or keep one of the list.
errors.ACCOUNT_SCOPE_ALONE: {{account}} is kept for conversations, and the list would hold no other account, so driven work would have none. Keep none first, or use another account beside it.
errors.ACCOUNT_USE_NO_LIST: This machine has no list of its own for {{agent}}, so there is nothing to use yet — turn on Use for its accounts first.
errors.ACCOUNT_USE_NO_LIST_workspace: {{workspace}} has no list of its own for {{agent}}, so there is nothing to use yet — choose Its own accounts and turn on Use for them first.
errors.ACCOUNT_USE_VALUE: {{value}} is not a value {{setting}} takes: a way to use accounts is goal or order, and near is a whole percent from 50 to 99.
errors.ACCOUNT_DEFAULT_OUTSIDE_LIST: {{agent}}'s list on this machine is {{list}}, and {{account}} is not in it — the list is every account its starts may run on, and the default is where they begin within it. Turn on Use for {{account}} first, or make one of the list the default.
errors.ACCOUNT_DEFAULT_OUTSIDE_LIST_work: {{agent}}'s list in {{workspace}} is {{list}}, and {{account}} is not in it — the list is every account its starts may run on, and the default is where they begin within it. Turn on Use for {{account}} first, or make one of the list the default.
errors.PLUGIN_UNKNOWN: There is no plugin called {{id}} on this machine.
errors.PLUGIN_ACTION_UNKNOWN: There is no plugin action called {{action}}.
errors.PLUGIN_BUSY: {{id}} was not removed: something on this machine still has a file in its folder open. Close it and remove it again — nothing was taken.
errors.PLUGIN_NOTHING_KEPT: {{id}} keeps nothing yet, so it has no data folder to open.
errors.SESSION_MOVE_NOT_YOURS: A person may finish, decline or stop a parked session — not move it to {{state}}. Answering it so it carries on is a message, not a move.
errors.SESSION_DECLINE_NEEDS_REASON: Declining needs a reason: it is the part whoever reads this record can act on.
errors.SESSION_UNKNOWN: There is no session {{session}} on this machine, so there was nothing to archive.
errors.SESSION_LIVE: {{session}} is still running, so it was not archived. Stop it first.
errors.SESSION_NEEDS_YOU: {{session}} is waiting on you, so it was not archived: archive never hides what needs you.
errors.SESSION_NEEDS_YOU_review: {{session}} has work to review, so it was not archived: archive never hides what needs you. Land its work or discard its tree first.
errors.QUEST_NOT_HELD: #{{id}} is neither parked nor held by your stop on this machine, so there is nothing to try again.
errors.QUEST_PAUSED: #{{id}} is paused with ask #{{pause}}; Resume carries it on.
errors.QUEST_PAUSED_quest: #{{id}} is paused on its own; Resume carries it on.
errors.WORK_UNKNOWN: There is no ask #{{id}} on this machine.
errors.WORK_REASON: Abandoning needs your reason: each declined quest keeps it.
errors.SESSION_UNKNOWN_folder: There is no session {{session}} on this machine, so there is no folder to open.
errors.SESSION_UNKNOWN_delete: There is no session {{session}} on this machine, so there was nothing to delete.
errors.SESSION_LIVE_delete: {{session}} is still running, so it was not deleted. Stop it first.
errors.SESSION_NOT_OURS: {{session}} ran on {{machine}}, and its record is theirs: it can only be archived here.
errors.SESSION_SERVED_QUEST: {{session}} worked on #{{quest}}, and its record is that work’s, so it was not deleted. Archive it instead.
errors.SESSION_SERVED_QUEST_took: {{session}} took a quest, and its record is that work’s, so it was not deleted. Archive it instead.
errors.SESSION_NAMED: Ask #{{ask}} names {{session}} as its intake, so its record stays. Archive it instead.
errors.SESSION_NAMED_quest: #{{quest}} was published by {{session}}, so its record stays. Archive it instead.
errors.SESSION_NAMED_landing: A landing names {{session}}, so its record stays. Archive it instead.
errors.SESSION_TREE_HERE: {{session}}’s tree is still on this machine, so it was not deleted. Discard the tree or clean it up first.
errors.SESSION_ON_REMOTE: The remote for {{workspace}} holds {{session}}: a delete here would not reach the team’s copy, so archive it instead.
errors.SESSION_FOLDER_GONE: The folder {{session}} worked in is not on this machine: the clean-up took its tree, or it ran somewhere else.
errors.SESSION_NOT_REVIEWABLE: This session's work is not on this machine — its record names no working tree here, as a record that came from another machine never does.
errors.SESSION_NO_BASE: This session's record does not say which commit it started from, so there is no range to measure — a record from before Daoris wrote that down keeps its evidence line only.
errors.SESSION_RANGE_UNREADABLE: git could not read this session's range where it ran — its tree has moved, been discarded, or no longer holds the commit it started from.
errors.SESSION_TREE_GONE: This session's tree is gone from this machine — a clean-up after its landing, or a discard, removed it — so there is nothing here to diff, and no tree to land or discard.
errors.SESSION_TREE_UNLISTED: git cannot list this session's files here — its tree is not on this machine, is gone, or is not a repository of its own. A path you type after @ still reaches the agent.
errors.PREVIEW_OUTSIDE_TREE: `{{path}}` is outside this session's tree, so the preview does not read it.
errors.PREVIEW_LINK_LEAVES_TREE: `{{path}}` goes through a link that leads out of this session's tree, so the preview does not read it.
errors.PREVIEW_GIT_FOLDER: `{{path}}` is inside `.git`, which is git's own folder rather than the session's work, so the preview does not read it.
errors.PREVIEW_NO_TREE: This session's record names no tree on this machine, or its tree is gone and no branch its landing made stands here to read instead, so there is no file here to show.
errors.PREVIEW_NOT_A_FILE: `{{path}}` is not a file in this session's tree now: it was deleted or moved, it is a folder, or it cannot be read.
errors.PREVIEW_NOT_ON_BRANCH: `{{path}}` is not a file on `{{branch}}`, the branch this session's work landed on: it was deleted or moved there, or it is a folder or a link.
errors.WINDOW_UNKNOWN: {{name}} is not a window this build opens. There are two: the monitor, and one session on its own.
errors.BROWSER_NOT_A_PAGE: {{address}} is not a web page, so it cannot be a favorite.
errors.BROWSER_FILE_UNREADABLE: {{file}} could not be read ({{problem}}). Fix it, or delete it to start from nothing — Daoris will not write over a file it could not read.
errors.BROWSER_SETTING_UNKNOWN: The extensions setting is offer or refuse, not {{value}}.
errors.BROWSER_CHOICE_UNKNOWN: The browser is Daoris's own or Edge, not {{value}}.
errors.BROWSER_LINKS_UNKNOWN: Links open in the system's browser or Daoris's, not {{value}}.
errors.BROWSER_LINK_NOT_A_PAGE: {{address}} is not a web page, so Daoris's browser will not open it.
errors.TERMINAL_SHELL_UNKNOWN: There is no shell called {{shell}}. A terminal runs PowerShell, Windows PowerShell, Command Prompt or Git Bash.
errors.TERMINAL_SHELL_MISSING: {{shell}} is not on this machine's PATH, so a terminal cannot run it.
errors.TERMINAL_NO_SHELL: This machine has no shell on its PATH for a terminal: PowerShell, Command Prompt or Git Bash.
errors.LOG_FILTER_UNKNOWN: The log cannot filter by {{filter}} {{value}}. A period is a span such as 30m, 2h or 3d; a source is desktop, host, mcp, browser or driver; a level is warn or error.
errors.LOG_FOLDER_NOT_OPENED: The log's folder would not open: {{problem}}
errors.TOOL_NOT_DOWNLOADED: {{tool}} {{version}} is not downloaded. Download it first.
errors.TOOL_FILE_MISSING: {{tool}} was not set to {{file}}: name a file that is there, by its whole path.
errors.TOOL_FILE_NO_VERSION: {{tool}} was not set to {{file}}, since it did not answer its version: {{reason}}
errors.TOOL_VERSION_UNKNOWN: No list names {{tool}} {{version}} for this machine. Look for updates fetches the lists, and Add location… adds one.
errors.TOOL_DOWNLOAD_REFUSED: {{tool}} {{version}} is refused by its `{{check}}` check, and nothing was fetched: {{message}}
errors.TOOL_LOCATION_REFUSED: {{address}} is not a resource location: an address is https://, or http:// to this machine.
errors.TOOL_IN_USE: {{tool}} runs {{version}}, so it was not deleted. Choose another way or version first.
errors.TOOL_BUSY: {{tool}} has a download running. Wait for it to end, or stop it, before starting another.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something on this machine refused, and did not say why. The driver's log has the detail.
errors.TIMEOUT: This machine did not answer in time — the driver may be busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.NO_TRANSPORT: This page is not connected to Daoris's desktop, so it cannot ask this machine anything.
errors.NO_HANDLER: This window has no part called {{module}} — the page is newer or older than the application. Restart Daoris.
errors.NO_ROUTE: {{module}} does not know {{type}} — the page is newer or older than the application. Restart Daoris.
errors.SCOPE_REQUIRED: {{module}} needs to be told which window it is for, and was not.
errors.MISSING_PAYLOAD_VALUE: The request was missing something it needs — the page is newer or older than the application.
errors.INVALID_PAYLOAD_VALUE: The request carried a value this application does not accept — the page is newer or older than the application.
errors.CAPABILITY_NOT_SUPPORTED: This window cannot do that here.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something on this machine failed, and did not say why. The driver's log has the detail.
